global_organization_chain: Open on the missing institution, not on the hazard

Turn a borrowed model into a policy by changing one inequality

main_argument_chains.claim: Small islands produce 18,230,968 displaced people over fifty years, twenty countries should receive them in entropy-weighted shares, and the policy must be revised because it leaves developing hosts in permanent deficit.
support_steps: Collapse four island states into one cone and scale to the world
Weight emissions, wealth, farmland and water by entropy
Price each host's net position over fifty years
Add a five-year update, an exemption and a fund
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Adopt the policy, but recompute the shares every five years and fund the hosts the model shows cannot cope.

warnings.warning: The radius-time relation is watermark-damaged. It is read from the stated geometry, rise equals height minus slope times radius, and not reconstructed beyond that.

The prose definitions of the two competition coefficients cross their subscripts. The equation as printed is kept and the coefficients are recorded only as inequalities.
No equation is printed for the economic account. It is assembled from the six bullet assumptions and flagged as reconstructed.
